intro: Across technology, cloud infrastructure, consumer IoT, database management, and mobile network operators, seven authorization-bypass articles published between 2026-05-08 and 2026-09-11 examine flaws that let attackers sidestep access controls. CVE-2026-7813 carries a CVSS score of 9.9, followed by CVE-2026-42880 at 9.6, CVE-2026-44574 and CVE-2026-44575 at 8.1 each, and CVE-2026-33357 at 7.5. The severity mix comprises one medium, three high, and two critical issues. Coverage spans the technology sector alongside cloud infrastructure, consumer IoT, database management, and mobile network operators.
